description: Binds an AgentIdentity.agent_id to one external identity surface: an A2A Agent Card, an organizational directory identity, or a verifiable credential. The profile field names exactly one block, which must be present while the other two are absent (AIB-1..3, enforced by the cross-field validator). Signatures are carried, not verified, and agent resolution plus binder authority are consumer-side (AIB-4, AIB-5).

binding_id.description: Stable opaque identifier for this binding record.

agent_id.description: AgentIdentity.agent_id this binding attaches an external identity to. Resolution is consumer-side (AIB-5).

profile.description: Identity-binding profile. Names exactly one of the a2a / directory / vc blocks, which MUST be present while the other two are absent (AIB-1..3).

card_url.description: URL the A2A Agent Card is published at. The library does not fetch it (AIB-N1).

card_hash.description: sha256 of the JCS (RFC 8785) canonical form of the fetched Agent Card. Consumers recompute and compare.

card_signature_jws.description: Compact JWS over the JCS-canonical Agent Card. Carried, not verified (AIB-4).

protocol_version.description: A2A protocol version the card declares (MAJOR.MINOR or MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH).

directory_kind.description: Kind of identity directory holding the agent object.

tenant_id.description: Directory tenant or realm identifier. Opaque to the library.

object_id.description: Directory object identifier of the agent. Opaque to the library.

accountable_role.description: The human role accountable for the agent. A role, not a person. Not validated against any directory (AIB-N2).

lifecycle_state.description: Directory lifecycle state of the agent object at bound_at (AIB-N5).

issuer.description: Credential issuer identifier (for example a DID or URL). Opaque to the library.

credential_type.description: Credential type name. Opaque to the library.

credential_hash.description: sha256 of the credential bytes as recorded by the binder. Consumers recompute and compare.

expires_at.description: Credential expiry. Not compared against any clock (AIB-N3).

bound_by_signer_id.description: Signer that recorded the binding. Authority to bind is consumer-side (AIB-5).

signature.description: Optional ed25519 signature by bound_by_signer_id. Carried, not verified (AIB-4).

contract_version.description: Hounfour contract version this binding was authored against.
